tasks.title: Interpreter resolution point + forge.cmd + doctor hook-health + windows CI
tasks.objective: The fail-open hole closes: every registered hook resolves its interpreter through one shared point that fails CLOSED within a working shell, cmd/PowerShell users can run forge natively, doctor executes hooks and reds what cannot run, and a windows-latest job proves the armed path instead of assuming it.
acceptance_criteria: Hook commands in BOTH runtime configs route through one resolution point (the plan proposes a forge hook <name> passthrough with the entrypoint owning the py -3 -> python3 -> python chain; the worker owns the exact form) that is byte-identical in behavior on POSIX and exits 2 (blocking) when no interpreter resolves - never 127-and-vanish. check_dual_runtime stays green.

forge.cmd (new, joins COPY_FILES) runs forge from cmd/PowerShell with zero setup: Git Bash sh when present, else py -3 / python directly against factory/scripts/forge.py. It also joins upgrade.py's UPGRADE_FILES so EXISTING clients receive it on forge upgrade, with the real upgrade leg asserting its presence — upgrade.py changes are LIMITED to that list entry (recurring classes repository-escape/reviewed-separately anchor there; tripwire per WORKFLOW.md — any other upgrade.py change escalates, never rides this stage).

doctor gains hook-health: loads both runtime configs, executes each registered command with a benign no-op JSON payload, asserts exit 0/2 semantics, reports a named RED row per failing hook; --fast stays existence-only; phase.py names doctor first on a hook-broken clone.
factory-scaffold.yml gains a windows-latest harness-only job running the lockout/degraded/companion gate selectors plus doctor hook-health; POSIX-only tests carry enumerated skip markers.

Full suite green on POSIX; live: after the config change, the session lockout still denies a product write and a recorder still works. KNOWN REGRESSION to fix first: hoisting repo = Path(...) to the top of cmd_doctor made the skill-pack loop (`for name, repo, extra, sentinel in skill_packs:` ~doctor.py:979) shadow-clobber it, so skills_missing_per_runtime(repo) later receives a pack-slug STRING and crashes (str / str at delegate.skill_groups) — rename the loop variable; test_project_audit_flags_discovery_without_roadmap (via sanitise _doctor_report) and a bare unpiped `./forge doctor` both prove the fix.

check_dual_runtime.check_hook_registration and test_hook_registration_extracts_every_registered_script understand the new command form (map hook name/entrypoint invocation to its factory/scripts/<name>.py and keep the existence assertion) — the passthrough must not hollow the extraction protection that was just repaired and pinned (human-settled 2026-08-11: passthrough design adopted WITH this coupling).

Landed review-hardened behavior survives the rework: pre_compact.py FACTORY_HOOK_HEALTH exits 0 only after read_hook_input, repo_root() and the forge_cli.scratchpad import, before any write; the init+upgrade propagation test keeps BOTH real generated-target legs with command-count guards before content checks; the missing-sh doctor branch keeps shell-specific remediation (Git for Windows), not the python fix.

Decision 0038 is rewritten for the settled design (single resolution point owned by the forge entrypoint, fail-closed exit 2/blocking; the inline command -v chain moves to REJECTED with the exit-127-fail-open evidence; token protection preserved via the mapping); status stays proposed.

Review round 5 — CLOSE THE CLASSES, not instances (two sibling rounds = enumerate exhaustively): (1) FAIL-CLOSED CLASS: every spawn-failure mode of the registered command maps to blocking exit 2 — missing sh (outer guard, landed by orchestrator: `sh -c '... || exit 2' || exit 2`, the outer || evaluated by cmd or bash), missing forge (127), missing forge.py (1), unresolvable interpreter — one test per mode pinning exit 2, and doctor/0038 document the double-guard form. Enumerate any remaining spawn mode you find and close it in the same shape. (2) DISCOVERY-BY-PROBE CLASS: nothing commits to a discovered executable without probing it — doctor's hook launcher check must resolve Git Bash the way the runtime does (CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH, standard Git-for-Windows locations — not only which('sh'), which false-reds healthy installs where Git\\cmd is on PATH but usr\\bin\\sh.exe is not); forge.cmd must probe that a discovered sh can actually run the launcher (a WSL sh cannot take the Windows path) and fall through to the version-probed py -3 / python chain on failure.

Review round 4 (passthrough diff): (a) the registered command form must normalize EVERY launch failure to blocking exit 2 — missing forge (127), missing factory/scripts/forge.py (1), unresolvable interpreter — the settled shape is appending `|| exit 2` inside the sh -c string (preserves 0; the orchestrator lands the 8 strings via degraded window; you update doctor/tests/0038 to pin that form and its semantics: genuine hook exit 2 passes through, all other nonzero become 2); (b) forge.cmd must PROBE each interpreter candidate (py -3, python) for >=3.10 before committing and fall through on probe failure — matching the sh launcher's version-gated chain, one point two entrances; (c) the os.name=='nt' rejection in forge.py must not recommend Git Bash (same CPython, same os.name) — name WSL2 or the genuinely supported route.

.gitattributes pins `forge text eol=lf` (and any other sh entrypoints this stage ships) so a Windows autocrlf checkout cannot CRLF-break the launcher, forge.cmd, or the hooks; the windows-latest job or a gate test proves the launcher survives an autocrlf=true checkout; existing .gitattributes rules (union-merge drivers) untouched.

Scope note, not work: docs/specs/windows-zero-setup.md changed inside this stage window via the parallel session's human-gated plan commit (1528235, spec narrowing + sibling split); it is listed in write scope only so the measured close is honest — do not edit it further.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "hook_health or forge_cmd or lockout or companion"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The hook-config edit is live in this repo the moment it lands - POSIX behavior must be byte-identical and the suite green before anything else; fail-closed means exit 2 from the resolution point, not from luck; the windows job must not weaken ubuntu coverage; forge.cmd must not fork the interpreter-resolution logic (one point, two entrances).
